title: In-home and online sessions: setup, privacy and records
audience: Tutors who run sessions in a family home, at a library or online
learningOutcomes: Set up a study space that is open, safe and appropriate for the learner
Protect the learner's personal information and work in session records
Stop a session that is unsafe, and record why

instruction.heading: The study space
instruction.body: Study space in a family home is set up in a shared room where the parent or guardian can see or hear the session if the policy requires it. The tutor checks the space for trip hazards, power points and any unsafe furniture before starting. The tutor does not use a bedroom or a room with the door closed unless the policy allows it and the record shows it.

instruction.heading: Privacy of learner information
instruction.body: Learner names, school names, work samples and any health or family information are private. They are kept on business systems, not on personal phones or personal email. Session notes stick to the learning goal and the learner's progress. Work samples are not shared online or with other families without written consent.

instruction.heading: Stopping a session
instruction.body: The tutor stops a session that becomes unsafe, for example if an adult in the home is aggressive, the learner is distressed in a way that cannot be settled, or the policy is broken. The tutor leaves in the agreed way, tells the business the same day, and records the reason. Stopping is recorded as a safety action and is not treated as a failed session.

procedure: Check the session space against the policy before the session starts
Confirm that the parent or guardian has agreed to the location and any observation rule
Store learner information only on business systems
Stop the session if it becomes unsafe, and leave in the agreed way
Record the session, any stop and the reason, and tell the business the same day

workedExamples.situation: A tutor arrives for an in-home session. The learner's parent is not home, and an adult the tutor has not met offers to sit in the bedroom with the learner during the session.
workedExamples.reasoning: The bedroom and an unknown adult are outside the agreed set-up. The tutor does not start the session in the bedroom, asks for the parent or guardian to confirm the arrangement, and if it is not confirmed, does not start. The decision and the reason are recorded and the business is told the same day.

equipmentAndPpe: Session location record for each home or venue
Business system for session notes and work samples

commonErrors.error: Storing learner work or notes on a personal phone.
commonErrors.prevention: Keep learner information on business systems only.

commonErrors.error: Continuing an unsafe session to avoid cancelling.
commonErrors.prevention: Stop, leave in the agreed way, and record it.

commonErrors.error: Starting a session in a room not in the agreed set-up.
commonErrors.prevention: Ask for the location to be confirmed. Do not start until it is.

qualityStandard: Each session location is recorded and matches the policy
Learner information is kept only on business systems
Each stopped session has a record with the reason and the business told the same day
documentationEvidence: Session notes limited to learning goals and progress
summary: Sessions take place in agreed, open, checked spaces
Learner information stays on business systems
An unsafe session is stopped, left and recorded

knowledgeChecks.question: A learner's work sample should be stored where?
An adult in a home becomes aggressive during a session. What is the right action?
options: Stop the session, leave in the agreed way, and record it

knowledgeChecks.question: A session is asked to move to a bedroom with the door closed. What happens?
options: It moves because the learner is comfortable
It does not move unless the policy allows it and the record shows it
It moves if the tutor leaves the door open
